verdict.rationale: Dagster's evidence shows it orchestrates and triggers syncs via Airbyte/Fivetran/dlt integrations, but nothing in the pack describes Dagster itself (or these integrations, as documented) performing log-based CDC (binlog/WAL) capture of inserts/updates/deletes. The story's specific mechanism—low-impact log-based replication—is unaddressed; Dagster is positioned as an orchestrator that calls out to these tools, not as the CDC engine itself.
